name: hotel-price-study
title: Hotel prices across booking sites: 17 snapshots, September 22 to October 10, 2026
description: 7,044 hotel prices in 368 cities from 17 snapshots (September 22 to October 10, 2026): for each hotel, every booking site's nightly rate that Google Hotels listed for the same 2-night stay, reduced to the going rate (the price most sites agree on), the cheapest listing and the site that had it, whether that listing named a room, whether its room name matched, and free cancellation. Plus two week-later repeats of the same stays. One CSV per snapshot. Collected by Underbook; see README.md for the method and its limits.

sources.title: Google Hotels, retrieved through the SerpApi google_hotels engine

resources.name: hotel-price-dispersion-2026-09
resources.title: Snapshot r1, September 22, 2026
resources.description: Snapshot r1: 25 large cities (US, Europe, Asia-Pacific), the first snapshot. Searched September 22, 2026 (UTC) for a 2-night stay 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-15 (21 days ahead), 2 adults, US market, US dollars. 426 hotels, one row each; 424 with a price.

fields.name: city
fields.description: The market searched: Google Hotels was asked for 'hotels in <city>'.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Study grouping, not a standard geography: US (United States); EU (Europe, including countries outside the European Union such as the UK, Norway, Switzerland and Iceland); AM (the Americas outside the US, including Canada, Latin America, the Caribbean and Puerto Rico); APAC (Asia-Pacific, which in this study also holds the Middle East, Istanbul, Cape Town and Marrakech).

fields.name: hotel
fields.description: Property name as Google Hotels listed it. Only results Google Hotels typed as a hotel (not a vacation rental) were kept.

fields.name: segment
fields.description: 'chain' when the hotel name matches a list of chain brand names fixed before the first run (Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG, Accor, Wyndham, Choice and others), otherwise 'independent'. A name rule: a chain hotel whose name carries no brand counts as independent.

fields.name: sites_listed
fields.description: Number of listing entries kept in the analysis for this hotel: the 12 lowest-priced entries, so never more than 12. A site that Google Hotels lists twice counts twice. The going rate and the cheapest price are computed from every entry, which for most hotels was more than 12. 0 when no price was returned.

fields.name: going_rate_usd
fields.description: The going rate, US dollars a night: the nightly price shared by the largest number of listings that offer free cancellation or name a room (all listings when none do), ties broken toward the lower price. Each listing's price is its before-tax nightly rate when the site reported one, otherwise the nightly rate it listed (which may include taxes and fees). Empty when no price was returned.

fields.name: cheapest_usd
fields.description: The lowest nightly price among all listings for the hotel, US dollars, on the same basis as going_rate_usd. Empty when no price was returned.

fields.name: cheapest_site
fields.description: The site with the lowest price, as Google Hotels names it (for example 'Booking.com', 'Expedia.ca', 'trivago DEALS'). Ties keep Google Hotels' order. Empty when no price was returned.

fields.name: discount_pct
fields.description: 100 x (going_rate_usd - cheapest_usd) / going_rate_usd, rounded to one decimal. To apply a threshold, compute it from the two price columns: rounding moves a few rows across a boundary. Empty when no price was returned.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: The label the Underbook price check gave on September 22, 2026. PARITY: no listing more than 5% below the going rate. UNVERIFIED_LOWER: the cheapest listing is more than 5% below the going rate and names no room. REAL_LOWER_MATCHED: the cheapest listing names a room and is more than 5% below the going rate; in this file it does NOT mean the room matched (rooms were not compared until September 23, 2026). none: no price was returned.

fields.name: cheapest_named_a_room
fields.description: In this file only: yes when the cheapest listing names a room AND is more than 5% below the going rate (the same rows as verdict REAL_LOWER_MATCHED). In the later files the column means only 'names a room'.

fields.name: fees_unverified
fields.description: yes when no listing for this hotel reported a before-tax rate, so every price for it is the rate as listed and fees such as resort or property fees may be missing from all of them. 'no' on rows without a price.

fields.name: check_in
fields.description: Check-in date searched (2 adults, 2 nights).

fields.name: check_out
fields.description: Check-out date searched.
